summary.reading: All 3 long-running video ads are the brands' own voice (Bold claim, Offer). The 5 creator-style posts ran 8 to 16 days each, between 2026-02 and 2026-07, and all have stopped. The library can't say whether those short runs paid off, so UGC in this market is a test to run, not a proven format to copy.
